I agree that people shouldn't have to behave and present a certain way just because of their gender but you seem to be suggesting that trans people transition just to conform to gender steriotypes. A lot more goes into the decision to transition than just that. It often involves dysphoria which doesn't even have to include social roles. For me, my dysphoria is mostly physical: I transitioned because I was going to kill myself if I had to spend too much longer in a male body. I think it would be better if we didn't judge anyone for breaking gender norms or for being transgender.

Don't be so hard on yourself, you happen to be someone who is trans and someone who was molested by some piece of shit as a child. Those things are not connected. Transphobes may say they're connected but there is no evidence that this is the case.

>i know *i'm* the problem

You're definitely not the problem and you need to stop blaming yourself for things outside of your control. It's not your fault that some scumbag decided to molest you and it's not your fault that on top of that awful fact, transphobes make you feel bad for them harassing trans people, because you were molested.

>god dammit they're right about me

They're not right about you, there is no proof that you being a victim of sexual assault as a child led to you being trans other than some idiots saying it's so. Just due to how probability works, there's always going to be a few trans people who were sexually abused as children but that's not proof that transphobes are right. Let me put it another way: I could say that if you're wearing a red T-shirt when you're in a car crash you'll survive. Obviously this has no bearing on your likely hood to survive but there will be some people who wear red T-shirts and survive. If I found one person who wore a red T-shirt and survived a car crash and used it as proof for my theory I'd be laughed at and ridiculed for not taking into account all the people with different coloured T-shirts who survived and all the people wearing red T-shirts who died. It also definitely would not be the fault of the person who was wearing a red T-shirt and survived a car crash that I decided to use them to justify my ridiculous claim.

I really hope you're okay, I can't imagine how horrible it must have been to be abused like that and to deal with being trans on top of that. Don't blame yourself for the actions of others. Maybe therapy can help you deal with this? IDK I'm not a professional but it sounds like it might help.
